title: Why Do We Feel Sad?
hook: Sadness is for loss and letdowns.
narration: Sadness is for loss and letdowns.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Feel Sad.
Tears can help your body reset.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Talking to a trusted person helps more than hiding.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Sad is not forever, even when it feels huge.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Sadness is for loss and letdowns.
The pictures today are a new heart world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we feel sad.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
